_about: Pictures for 聽解 items, as on the JLPT paper (official samples, 2026-10-22): grid = one 2x2 image whose four panels are the four options of a 課題理解 item (N5/N4); scene = one picture with one arrow at the speaker for 発話表現 (N5–N3). Key = level/set/item index; 'first' must be the start of the item's first line (plain text), so a moved item is caught by tools/build_listening.py. Drawn by tools/build_listening_img.py into data/listening/img/<lang>/<id>.webp. Times, dates, counts and things a wordless picture can't tell apart stay as text (owner's pick); so does the N5 map question (ja_n5/m1/4): three tries never drew one clean route a panel.
